title: Father Wants Us Dead
description: NJ.com reporters Rebecca Everett and Jessica Remo investigate New Jersey family murders. Season 1 covers John List, the accountant and Sunday school teacher who killed his wife, mother and three children in 1971, then vanished and lived under a new name for 18 years. Season 2, Uncle Paul, covers the 2018 killings of Keith, Jennifer, Jesse and Sophia Caneiro, which first looked like a mansion fire in Colts Neck.
short_description: Two NJ.com reporters investigate New Jersey family murders, from John List in 1971 to the Caneiro killings in 2018.
